decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already records that the referral code appears directly on the NFT, in metadata, on the dashboard, and optionally in email.
The referral code was already required in NFT metadata and its mint-number source remains unchanged; adding the NFT itself as a separate display surface does not change metadata accuracy.
Changing where the referral code is displayed does not alter the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, or timing.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter commission allocation when no referral code is entered.
The display location of the referral code does not change badge milestones, award conditions, or on-chain badge recording.
The referral-code display-surface change does not affect winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain verification.
The source leaves resale transfer semantics unchanged; adding the NFT as a referral-code display surface does not alter which entitlements or state transfer to the buyer.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter Big Block prizes, draw triggers, ticket eligibility, resets, or pool funding.
The referral-code display-surface change does not affect the manual one-click prize claim flow or its Winners-page location.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter Small Block prizes, draw cadence, ticket eligibility, resets, or pool funding.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter the Winners page as the prize-announcement channel.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter mint price, founder share, commission share, or prize-pool revenue destinations.
